notes: Rejected 2026-10-26 (F-03): opened as a cordless lamp for the living room's seats (the final audit found no seat with a lamp it can read by). The page's rows: Finish Type Polished, Base Material Plastic, Lamp Type Desk Lamp, 6.3 x 2.76 x 6.3": a small foldable plastic desk lamp (the title's "Foldable, Nail, Emergency"), not a table lamp for a staged living room, and no lumen row. Its bullets: a built-in 3600 mAh battery, a Type-C port and a 19.68" cable, 10 brightness levels, touch control. First organic result for 'rechargeable led table lamp dimmable reading'; the other results on that page are desk and clip lamps or two-packs of cordless decor lamps whose pages were not opened. A cordless lamp bright enough to read by (300 lumens or more, dimmable, no glass, F-21) stays to find.
